profile.headline: AI Software Engineer
profile.summary:
I build the systems that make ML fast, reliable, and scalable in production.
  At LinkedIn, I work on feature serving and inference AI infrastructure at 10K+ QPS — the
  foundational layer between raw data and live ML models.

  ━━━ What I've shipped at LinkedIn ━━━

  • High-throughput feature service that offloaded computation
    from model serving, improving throughput by 10x at production scale

  • Built an inference layer supporting streaming inference and real-time
    feature logging — capturing production feature signals to feed downstream
    training pipelines

  • Developed a featurelog training dataset framework for incremental training
    — closing the loop between live feature serving and model retraining,
    eliminating training-serving skew and ensuring consistent model behavior
    in production

  • Built feature lineage tracking and compliance infrastructure aligned with
    FLA/DMA requirements — enabling full auditability of feature data flow
    from source to model serving

  • Unified feature format framework enabling zero-copy Tensor conversion via
    Apache Arrow columnar format — reducing memory overhead and serialization
    latency in high-throughput inference paths

  • Own core APIs and service-level design for feature serving workflows
    focused on scalability, reliability, latency, and developer experience

  ━━━ Background ━━━

  Before LinkedIn, I worked at Salesforce as a Principal Engineer on the
  Einstein AI Platform — building ML infrastructure serving billions of
  predictions daily across Sales, Service, Marketing, and MuleSoft.

  I owned three critical platform services:
  • Modelstore — blob + metadata storage for 100K+ ML models
  • MLConfig — multi-tenant model versioning, canary + staggered deployments
  • AI Metadata Storage — LLM trust config, RAG grounding, CoPilot artifacts

  Platform runs at B2C scale: 100K+ req/sec, real-time inference, AutoML,
  hyperparameter tuning, and complex ML graph serving — integrating OpenAI,
  Hugging Face, Nvidia Triton, TensorFlow, and PyTorch.

  ━━━ How I work ━━━

  I own systems end to end: design, implementation, SLA/SLO/SLI, runbooks,
  and on-call. I care about developer experience upstream as much as
  production reliability downstream.

  ━━━ Tech ━━━

  Java · Python · Scala · Spark · Flink · Airflow · Kafka · HDFS · Avro ·
  Arrow · Kubernetes · Docker · Terraform · AWS · Redis · Elasticsearch ·
  Databricks · PyTorch · TensorFlow · CUDA · GPU Inference · LLM ·
  SageMaker · Helm · Spinnaker

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer
positions.description:
Building production-scale ML infrastructure at the intersection of distributed systems, backend platform engineering, and machine learning. Core contributor to LinkedIn's Feature Platform — the foundational layer between raw data and live ML models serving 100+ ML teams across the company. Specializing in Feature Serving Infrastructure, including:

Agentic Development & TensorFlow→PyTorch Migration: Driving platform-wide migration from TensorFlow to PyTorch using AI-assisted development, agent-driven code refactoring, test generation, and PR review across shared serving libraries and model onboarding paths.

Feature Serving: Led design and launch of a high-throughput feature serving service that offloaded computation from model serving infrastructure, delivering 10x inference throughput improvement at 10K+ QPS with p99 latency of 20ms for feature fetching.

Streaming Inference & Feature Logging: Built an inference layer supporting streaming inference and real-time feature logging — capturing 10TB+/day of production feature signals to feed downstream training pipelines.

Featurelog Training Dataset Framework: Developed a dataset generation framework for incremental offline and online training — closing the loop between live feature serving and continuous model retraining, eliminating training-serving skew across thousands of production features.

Feature Lineage & Compliance: Built feature lineage tracking and compliance infrastructure aligned with FLA/DMA requirements — enabling full auditability of feature data flows from source to model serving.

Unified Feature Format (Zero-Copy Tensor): Engineered zero-copy Arrow byte to Tensor conversion via Apache Arrow columnar format — reducing serialization latency by 60% in high-throughput inference paths.

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer ML/AI
positions.description:
Specializing in Einstein Machine Learning Services, including:

AI Metadata Service (Einstein GPT → Agentforce Foundation): Storage and runtime substrate for LLM trust configuration, retrievers, planners, CoPilots, function calls, and RAG dynamic grounding — the agentic infrastructure powering Einstein GPT and the foundation Salesforce Agentforce.

Modelstore: Offers storage for both Model Blob and Metadata, supporting up to a hundred thousand models. It also features comprehensive APIs for querying and reusing metadata tailored for ML scenarios.

MLConfig: Manages application provisioning, ML code, model versioning, and configuration storage. It's designed for multi-tenancy and supports canary and staggered code deployments.

Data Exploration Service: Enables Data Scientists to delve into production data using Databricks and conduct online model experiments via AWS SageMaker.

Model Validation (Experimentation) Service: Focuses on offline experimentation, validating experiments against production data and generating evaluative metrics.

positions.title: Lead Software Engineer
positions.description: Built Machine Learning platform capabilities which included Data Experimentation, Versioning, and Deployment for multi-tenant environments

positions.title: Lead Software Engineer
positions.description: Worked in Einstein Platform to build “Einstein Prediction Builder” to predict Salesforce custom model based on the customer use case.

positions.title: Sr Software Engineer
positions.description: Worked in the Field Service team as a founding Field Service team member, where we built a better new Field Service product for scheduling and dispatching technician experience in Service Cloud.

educations.schoolName: Birla Institute of Technology and Science, Pilani
